shared_elements: linear incised/outlined marks on a flat stone surface
a row of repeated short strokes set along a line (boat crew strokes / row of runic characters)
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry thin linear marks, including a row of repeated short strokes ranged along a line (the crew-strokes of A's boat versus the character sequences of B), which any linear tradition could produce independently. Otherwise the content is wholly different: A shows a figurative scene with a large striding human brandishing an axe-like implement, a horned quadruped and a manned boat, while B shows no creatures or objects at all, only rectilinear framing bands, a vertical stem and an arc filled with sign-like characters.
